title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, information exposure, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People observe mask use among their network neighbors and adjust their propensity to wear masks based on conformity, thresholds, and observed norms.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and authorities enforce mask mandates; non-compliance may lead to penalties or denial of entry, affecting future compliance.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Media channels broadcast messages that affect risk perception and trust; misinformation can decrease adoption.

interactions.name: mask_acquisition
interactions.description: People purchase masks from retailers depending on availability, price, and personal resources; ownership affects ability to comply.

interactions.name: norm_signaling_at_locations
interactions.description: Observed compliance at locations (e.g., signage and visible mask use) updates perceived local norms and influences behavior.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each timestep and the average over the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days required to reach a predefined adoption threshold (e.g., 80%).

metrics.name: adoption_by_location_type
metrics.description: Average mask-wearing rate observed within each location type (work, school, retail, transit).

metrics.name: voluntary_vs_mandatory_share
metrics.description: Proportion of mask use driven by voluntary choice versus mandated compliance.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across demographic or income groups (e.g., Gini or coefficient of variation).

metrics.name: policy_violations_count
metrics.description: Total number of non-compliance events detected at locations under mandates.

metrics.name: mask_access_shortages
metrics.description: Frequency and duration of stockouts at retailers and fraction of agents unable to obtain masks when desired.
